## Area

- [ ] Window of Tolerance routing
- [ ] Wim Hof confirmations
- [ ] Bilateral cueing wording or gates
- [ ] Panic anchor
- [ ] Crisis directory presentation
- [ ] Copy that could read as a diagnosis, a score, guilt, or a streak
- [ ] A `// CLINICAL SAFETY` comment

## File or screen

Path, and the user-facing sentence or safety comment you read.

## Clinical concern

What could go wrong for someone who is overwhelmed, present, or flat and numb. Name the state the gate is meant to protect.

## Suggested change

Gates stay deterministic rules in the app. They are not a score and not a diagnosis. Bilateral cueing stays grounding and attention, not EMDR or trauma reprocessing.

## Your role

Clinician, peer reviewer, or lived-experience reviewer. Do not include a personal request for treatment advice.
